newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end edgy trade modestly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end edgy trade modestly lower.

text.p: U.S. debt futures ended edgy pit trading modestly lower after late afternoon activity picked up.

June Treasury bond futures downticked during the final few minutes, touching the pit session's low at 108-09/32 which brokers said approximated the seven percent cash yield level, given the day's tiny shift in basis.
But one dealer bought some 4,000 June T-bonds into the close in what some brokers called a hedge against a cash basket after the firm had rolled out of March futures that expired at noon.
